description: The frozen wire values for this contract: every enumeration member, every record field ordinal, and every tagged-union variant, recorded once. The generator compares this file against schema/contract.json on every run. A value that moved, was reused, was retyped, or was removed is refused and no flag permits it, because a reader built before the change would decode the bytes after it as something else without noticing. An appended value is recorded here only by `--refreeze`, which needs the contract version raised in the same change, and which will not touch a frozen payload unless that codec's own schema_version was raised too.
